newsitem.title: USA: CSX encouraged by U.S. schedule on Conrail.
newsitem.headline: CSX encouraged by U.S. schedule on Conrail.

text.p: CSX Corp said it remains encouraged about its proposed partial acquisition of Conrail Inc following the U.S. Surface Transportation Board's announcement of a 350-day review of the proposed transaction.
"We would have preferred the shorter schedule, but we're encouraged by the news and the schedule," said CSX spokesman Thomas Hoppin.

CSX and Norfolk Southern, which are buying Conrail in a $10.3 billion transaction and will then divide its assets, had asked the STB to review the deal in 255 days. Other parties that will be affected by the division of Conrail had requested the agency set a longer review period.

The transaction calls for Norfolk Southern to pay $5.9 billion for 58 percent of Conrail and CSX to pay $4.3 billion for the rest of the East Coast railroad. The two railroads last week closed their joint tender offer for Conrail and they now own 96 percent of its outstanding shares.
Hoppin said the two railroads still intend to submit their detailed plan to the STB on June 16.
